Name: Starblue Valley Unofficial
Author: CherrySymphony
Description:
[size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] has always been my favorite recolor mod, but it has unfortunately gone abandoned for about three years now. I decided I would update Starblue Valley to 1.6 (and update leftover 1.5 content) so I could keep using it for myself, but also to share it with the other Starblue lovers out there.

This is a Work in Progress! A lot of tilesheets still need to be updated.
I intend to update this as quickly and as regularly as I and others are able until everything is converted!

Updated items have been moved to the Changelog to prevent this page from getting huge, please check there for specifics on things that have been updated. :)
[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][color=#ff0000][size=3]NOTE[/size][/color][size=3]:[/size][/b]
[size=3]Due to how Starblue Valley was setup, I had to port the old assets into this mod in order to get some things functioning right. Because of this, you[/size][size=3] need ONLY this mod and not the original Starblue Valley. However I want it to be noted that [/size][color=#ffd966][size=4]Starblue Valley belongs to Lita/Strangelyliteral[/size][/color][size=3], and I do not claim any ownership of their work!

If they return and wish for this mod to be taken down, it will be done so without question.

[color=#93c47d][b]Bugs:[/b][/color]
If you encounter any bugs or notice any issues, please let me know via the bugs tab and I will get to it asap!

[b][color=#ffd966]Config Options:[/color][/b][/size][b]
NOTE: Some configs are currently unimplemented or only partially implemented!

[/b][list]
[*][b]Overworld Recolor[/b]: recolors the grass, dirt, festivals, and other overworld elements - default: true
[*][b]Caves and Mines[/b]: recolors the caves and mines across the Valley and Ginger Island - default: true
[*][b]Spring Grass[/b]: green or blue - default: green
[*][b]Lava[/b]: vanilla or a slightly less saturated version - default: none
[*][b]Island Sky[/b]: vanilla or a slightly less saturated version of the sky on Ginger Island - default: none
[*][b]Grass[/b]: basic (seasonally recolored vanilla), flowering (shorter and more floral), or none (vanilla) - default: basic
[*][b]Trees[/b]: determines if trees are affected by the recolor
[*][b]Crops[/b]: determines if crops are recolored - default: false
[*][b]Oak Trees[/b]: pink or green color options - default: pink
[*][b]Maple Trees[/b]: green or white color options - default: green
[*][b]Pine Trees[/b]: pine (green) or spruce (blue) color options - default: pine
[*][b]Forever Pink[/b]: determines if oak trees remain pink all year - default: false
[*][b]Blossom Fruit Trees[/b]: whether fruit trees should be recolored or not - default: true
[*][b]Bushes[/b]: recolors the bushes - default: true
[*][b]Farm Buildings[/b]: seasonally recolors farm buildings, including the shipping bin, gold clock, silo, well,  and junimo huts - default: true
[*][b]Town Buildings[/b]: seasonally recolors the buildings in Pelican Town - default: true
[*][b]Ginger Island Buildings[/b]: recolors the buildings on Ginger Island - default: true
[*][b]Farm House[/b]: If the farmhouse is recolored
[*][b]Greenhouse[/b]: If the greenhouse is recolored
[*][b]Sheds[/b]: If sheds are recolored
[*][b]Cabins[/b]: If multiplayer cabins are recolored
[*][b]Coops[/b]: If the three coop types are recolored
[*][b]Barns[/b]: If the three barn types are recolored
[*][b]Obelisks[/b]: determines if the five warp obelisks are recolored - default: true
[/list][list]
[*][b]Mailbox[/b]: basic (seasonally recolored vanilla), fancy (iron with seasonal foliage), or none (vanilla) - default: basic
[*][b]Fences[/b]: determines if fences are recolored - default: true (partially implements)
[*][b]Flooring[/b]: determines if the flooring/paths are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Pet Bowl[/b]: determines if pet bowls are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Ground Under Pet Bowl[/b]: default, grass, dirt, void, darkgrass - these are options for [u]custom farms[/u] and [u]may not work currently[/u]
[*][b]Exterior Spouse Items[/b]: determines if outdoor spouse items are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Craftables[/b]: determines if craftable items are seasonally recolored - default: true
[*][b]Scarecrows[/b]: determines if scarecrows and rarecrows are seasonally recolored - default: true
[*][b]Interiors[/b]: determines if building interiors are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Ginger Island Interiors[/b]: determines if building interiors on Ginger Island are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Walls and Floors[/b]: determines if indoor wallpaper and floors are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Furniture[/b]: determines if furniture is recolored - default: true
[*][b]Spookier Cursed Mannequin[/b]: Enables a spookier version of the cursed mannequin - default: false
[*][b]Interior Spouse Items[/b]: determines if spouse rooms inside the Farmhouse are recolored (this is meant for compatibility with other mods that affect spouse rooms) - default: true
[*][b]Shane Clean Spouse Floor[/b]: removes the footprints from Shane's spouse room (this is meant for compatibility with other Shane fix mods while also keeping the recolor) - default: false
[*][b]Interface[/b]: determines if the user interface should be recolored - default: true
[*][b]World Maps[/b]: determines if the farm, valley, and island maps are recolored - default: true
[*][b]Colorful Title[/b]: recolors the leaves on the title screen to be more colorful - default: true
[/list][b]
[size=3]Config Translations: [/size][/b]
A big thank you to those who have reached out and provided config option translations!
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#ea9999]Portuguese [/color]translation provided by [color=#f6b26b]Konoxz[/color][/size]
[*][size=3][color=#ea9999]Spanish [/color]translation provided by [color=#f6b26b]Cris0007[/color][/size]
[*][size=3][color=#ea9999]German [/color]translation provided by [color=#f6b26b]ToraXela[/color][/size]
[*][color=#efefef]Remaining config translations were done by non-native speakers. If you notice an issue or inaccuracy, please let me know![/color]
[/list]If you would like to provide translations for the config options, please reach out to me on Discord! [size=2](username: cherrysymphony)[/size]
[size=3][b]Compatibility:[/b]
Currently this mod has all of the same compatibility that the original[/size] [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] does, so please reference that mod pages description.

A compatibility file has been included in the optional downloads for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19850]Starblue Valley Interface for Bigger Backpack [/url]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/86813923]Alexisls69[/url]. Thank you so much Alexisls for letting me include your work here!
